scope: Actual UI submit/update/event/sync functions and quick module with tiny callback/DOM stubs, plus static control preservation. No physics scheduler, rendered layout, GPU or FPS claim.

results.name: Actual UI defaults expose independent automatic ranges and preserve manual settings
Turning off each random mode disables its range and retains fixed/manual values
Actual numeric handlers forward both original bounds without sorting or sign loss
Callback rejection restores state and the still-focused invalid range input
Signed-angle, nonfinite and explicit declined edits revert without changing unrelated diagnostics
An older asynchronous failure cannot overwrite a newer accepted edit
Existing source/profile/smoke edits remain shared; rejected auto leaves paused playback
Real sync metadata determines capacity; quick status reports interval and signed tilt
All prior controls and closed numeric domains are preserved with accessible labels
